title: Villagers ride Chickens
description: Allows you to mount Villagers on Chickens via /trigger for easier Transportation
body:
## What this Datapack does
Lets you mount a Villager on a Chicken for easier Transportation.
Technically, this is a Vanilla feature, as there is a chance that a Chicken Jockeys spawns as a Baby Zombie Villager that, when cured stays mounted on the chicken.

![3 Villagers on Chickens](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LjoBIMVM/images/9bc793ccf27bc43129e250f898d7bf80a885031d.png)

## Why?
A friend asked me to set up a server-side mod that allows villagers to be leashed, as they wanted to move them around more conveniently. After watching a video by Zedaph, I created this datapack to accomplish that task without a more resource-intensive mod or datapack while still staying kind of vanillaish.
